name: laya_mem_consolidation
description: Laya-Mem periodic non-destructive consolidation (write-side). Port of memory/jev_questions.consolidation_questions for one candidate pair (new_memory vs candidates[0]). 5 decisions: 4 noul (redundant / contradiction / obsolete / link) + 1 Choice (representation: keep_separate / merge / promote). Default threshold 0.85 per Jev-Mem's `consolidation_threshold`. Action emits one label per consolidation-link subtype when the corresponding noul crosses threshold, plus the representation choice verdict as copy_keys. Caller loops pairs N times with `pair_{i}_*` prefix to handle more than 1 candidate. Contradiction at threshold forces keep_separate (non-destructive); merge/promote only when contradiction < threshold AND the representation probability >= threshold.

pair_0_redundant.instructions: Compare `new_memory.content` with `candidates[0].content`. Do these observations repeat the same fact with no additional recallable detail?
pair_0_redundant.truthy: One is a duplicate or paraphrase without a new detail or time-specific update.
pair_0_redundant.falsy: They provide different details or describe distinct occurrences.

pair_0_contradiction.instructions: Compare `new_memory.content` with `candidates[0].content`. Do these accounts assert incompatible facts about the same subject at the same time?
pair_0_contradiction.truthy: Claims cannot both hold at the stated time and context.
pair_0_contradiction.falsy: Compatible claims, uncertainty, or a change over time that explains the difference.

pair_0_obsolete.instructions: Compare `new_memory.content` with `candidates[0].content`. Does the new memory explicitly replace the candidate's previously valid fact with an updated fact?
pair_0_obsolete.truthy: An explicit update supersedes the earlier fact for current-state questions.
pair_0_obsolete.falsy: No explicit replacement; mere recency or a separate event is insufficient.

pair_0_link.instructions: Compare `new_memory.content` with `candidates[0].content`. Would following a link between these observations help answer a future recall question?
pair_0_link.truthy: The connection supplies related, corroborating, correcting or contrasting evidence.
pair_0_link.falsy: There is no specific connection useful for recall.

pair_0_representation.instructions: Compare `new_memory.content` with `candidates[0].content`. Which representation best fits the relationship between these two observations? Judge from the supplied accounts; do not assume answers to other questions.

criteria.keep_separate: Contradictory accounts, unique details that a combined representation would lose, or distinct facts/events without a supported general pattern.
criteria.merge: Compatible accounts of the same fact or event can be combined without losing unique details.
criteria.promote: Distinct repeated episodes explicitly support a stable general pattern suitable for semantic abstraction; prefer this over merge for repeated events.
criteria.uncertain: Insufficient evidence to choose a safe combined or separate representation.
